svg.aria-label: A 4 by 4 depth image reduced to level 0, 2 by 2, and level 1, 1 by 1. Each texel keeps the largest, farthest, of the four below it: level 0 holds 0.6, 0.9, 0.5 and 0.8, and level 1 holds 0.9.
